scope: Offline public HAL and saved1.50.10 code review. No hardware access, watchdog ping, disable, clock/reset write, or core execution by this agent.

public_watchdog_registers.implementation: SP805-style register layout explicitly named by public hal_wdt.c; this is not the DesignWare CCVR layout
public_watchdog_registers.limitation: Identifying the DSP watchdog does not identify every MCU/AON/PMU watchdog or firmware cross-core liveness timeout. DSP CONTROL0 alone would only disable this instance.

actual_firmware_hal_confirmation.start: 0x383d7244: MOV r4,#0x1000; MOVT r4,#0x5800; writes key1acce551 at+C00, cached LOAD at+0, clears interrupt at+C, CONTROL3 at+8, re-locks
actual_firmware_hal_confirmation.ping: 0x383d7300: reloads LOAD using cache0x38514fbc when start flag0x38514fc0 is set
actual_firmware_hal_confirmation.set_timeout: 0x383d7364: getter0x383ceee0, UMULL frequency*timeout_seconds, minus1, clamp, store0x38514fbc
actual_firmware_hal_confirmation.get_timeleft: 0x383d73b4: VALUE, RIS; if RIS0 adds cached LOAD+1; divides by frequency getter

runtime_frequency.units: Software-calibrated ticks per second used by this actual WDT HAL
runtime_frequency.caution: Read the live word; do not use the initialized16000, nominal32kHz, or an assumed26MHz. Software calibration alone does not establish hardware debug freeze.

NuttX_lower_driver.start_call: 0x38003a0e calls HAL timeout with ldrb r1,[object,#4];0x38003a14 starts controller
NuttX_lower_driver.timeout_set_call: 0x38003ade: input milliseconds divided by1000, byte stored at lower-object+4, passed as HAL seconds
NuttX_lower_driver.timeout_value: Actual per-instance timeout byte not yet read. Live LOAD and frequency permit estimating the current stage without locating that object.

parent_reported_live_read.interpretation: This watchdog is enabled for interrupt/reset. Its remaining seconds must use the live runtime frequency, then be corroborated by actual countdown or source selector; no value is assumed here.

read_only_clock_selector_candidate.limitation: Macro names identify a selector but do not prove exact frequency or freeze wiring. Do not modify it.

debug_freeze_status.public_review: No explicit halt/watchdog-freeze selection found in hal_wdt.c, hal_cmu_best2003.c or reg_cmu_best2003.h. WDT has separately controlled O_WDT_AP/AP_WDT clocks and resets; CPU0 debug halt does not itself prove those are gated.
debug_freeze_status.do_not_use: hal_cmu_dsp_stop_cpu/reset_hold or clock_disable as a substitute: they reset/gate A7 and shared memory/peripherals, rather than preserve a debug pause.

future_short_pause_gate.before_halt: Read live frequency word, CONTROL, VALUE and RIS; verify known frequency range and large countdown margin. Reject RIS1 and unexpected CTRL bits for the first screen test; do not rely on the additional second-stage LOAD as slack.
future_short_pause_gate.conservative_margin: Use VALUE/frequency as time until the next stage, even when RIS0; require this to exceed the complete pause+restore+transport budget by a substantial margin, e.g.5seconds for a1second demonstration. Refresh immediately before HRQ because earlier reads age.
future_short_pause_gate.100ms_counter_probe: After confirmed HALTED/InstrCompl and stable PRSR, capture VALUE and host time, hold at most100ms, capture VALUE/time again, then immediately RRQ and restore both locks using the already validated cleanup. Keep PRSR latches active and all possible-write flags. No WDT writes.
future_short_pause_gate.counter_probe_limits: A decrease proves the counter is not fully frozen during that interval; estimate ticks/s from delta/time only if no reload, underflow or status/control change. An increase suggests reload/wrap and is inconclusive. An unchanged value alone needs a running-state control sample and adequate timing resolution before claiming debug freeze.
future_short_pause_gate.screen_pause_limits: Still bounds only the identified CPU0. Other cores, MCU, DMA, LCDC and watchdogs remain active; automatic restore/resume can be delayed by an individual transport failure.
